## Highlights

- **A large, detailed picture reaches the model.** A PNG of a scan, a photo or a busy screenshot that was still over 2 MB after the composer made it smaller was left out of the model's request, and the model answered that it could not read the image ([#5396](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/issues/5396)). The composer now fits every picture it can redraw under the 2 MB a model is shown: one without transparency becomes a JPEG, at a lower quality and then a smaller size until it fits; one with transparency stays a PNG at a smaller size first. A picture already under 2 MB is not stepped down further: it is redrawn as before, and kept as it was when the redraw would be larger. Pictures attached to a task are only redrawn, as before.
  - An image the composer cannot make smaller, such as an animated GIF over 2 MB, is named under the attachments before you send: the model gets only its file name. Sent anyway, the model is told why the picture is missing, so its answer says so instead of claiming it cannot read it.
  - A picture the composer turns into a JPEG is stored and sent as a JPEG. A converted WebP used to keep its WebP type, which a provider that checks the bytes can refuse; pictures already stored that way are sent to the model with the right type too.
- **Admins can block a member's personal API key in their organization** ([#5397](https://github.com/tale-project/tale/issues/5397)). An Owner or Admin opens **Settings > Members**, the member's row menu, **Personal API keys**, and blocks a key there. Its requests to this organization are refused with 403 `API_KEY_BLOCKED` on the REST API, the MCP endpoint and the model endpoints, while it keeps working in the holder's other organizations; the same roles lift the block.
  - An Admin cannot block or free an Owner's key, nobody blocks their own key, and a key made for the organization, a team, a project or a member is ended rather than blocked, as before.
  - The holder is told in the bell, and their own key list marks the key **Blocked in this organization**. **All keys in this organization** leaves out a member's key blocked here.
  - Each block and each lift is an audit log entry, `api_key.blocked` or `api_key.unblocked`, naming who did it and the key by its masked ends.

## Upgrade notes

- **Database:** migration `0231_api_key_org_blocks.sql` adds the table `app.api_key_org_blocks`. It is applied at startup like every migration, after the ones v0.5.101 brought: its number is lower because the stable and the feature line share migration numbers. It only adds a table, so the previous image keeps working during a rolling deploy; a block made while that image still serves holds from the moment the roll ends.
- **API contract `3.53.0`:** a person's own API key that an organization blocked answers 403 `API_KEY_BLOCKED` for every request to that organization, with `data.organizations` listing the organizations where the key still works (the model endpoints answer the code in their own error shape, without the list). A client that already handles 403 needs no change; one that switches organizations can read the list.
- **Images:** no action. A picture over 2 MB stored before this release is still not sent to the model; the model now says why, and attaching it again lets the composer make it smaller.
- No configuration or environment variable changes.
